'''2009 Worlds Team Tournament John Sonneburg LS I Have A Bad Feeling About This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[John Sonneburg]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Team Tournament).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[I Have A Bad Feeling About This]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
